improvements.action: Debug and fix the zone score fallback pipeline — verify that supply zone scoring actually runs when AI is unavailable; log each Nifty 50 symbol's fallback score to identify if scores are being computed as zero/null or if the threshold is simply too high

improvements.action: Lower the fallback minimum zone score threshold from its current value to at least 60 (or whatever produces 5-10 candidates on a typical day); backtest the last 5 sessions to calibrate
improvements.reason: The fallback is designed for days when AI is down, but if it filters out everything it defeats its purpose entirely — today zero setups from 50 stocks is proof the threshold is miscalibrated

improvements.action: Add a regime-aware bias to the fallback: when regime=trending_down, automatically boost supply zone scores by +10 and penalize demand zone scores by -10 so SHORT setups surface more readily
improvements.reason: ADX=25 with Nifty -0.6% is a textbook environment for shorting at supply zones; the fallback should reflect the macro direction rather than treating both sides equally

improvements.action: Implement a minimum-recommendation floor: if the scan produces zero setups, relax filters iteratively (drop min score by 5, widen entry tolerance by 0.2%) until at least 3 candidates surface, then flag them as 'low-confidence'
improvements.reason: A zero-output day is worse than a low-confidence trade day — at minimum the system should surface watchlist candidates for manual review
